item.title: Local Roundup: Vanden girls basketball advances to semifinals, boys fall to Modesto Christian
item.description: The fifth-seeded Lady Vikings trounced fourth-seeded Lincoln 70-24 in the Sac-Joaquin Section Division I quarterfinals on Thursday. Vanden will head to Stockton to face top-seeded St. Mary’s in the semifinals on Tuesday.
